info.title: MailSentinel API
info.description: Watch many mailboxes, match rules, and get the important ones on WhatsApp.

schema.title: Response List Destinations Api V1 Destinations Get

post.description: Link a WhatsApp group: add the MailSentinel number to the group and post this code there.

schema.title: Response List Mailboxes Api V1 Mailboxes Get
Response Imap Presets Api V1 Mailboxes Imap Presets Get

parameters.name: send

schema.description: Also ask for permission to send email (WhatsApp /email)
schema.title: Send

parameters.description: Also ask for permission to send email (WhatsApp /email)

get.description: Current server settings of an IMAP mailbox (no passwords), to prefill the update form.

put.description: Fix an IMAP mailbox that needs re-authentication (new app password, host, ...). Keeps its history.

schema.title: Response Rule Fields Api V1 Rules Fields Get
Response List Rules Api V1 Rules Get
Response Reorder Api V1 Rules Order Put

post.description: Dry-run a condition against a sample email or against recent mail in one of your mailboxes.

schema.title: Response List Templates Api V1 Email Templates Get

get.description: Exactly what the bot sends on WhatsApp for `/email <name>`.

schema.title: Response Timeseries Api V1 Stats Timeseries Get

get.description: Server-sent events: message.matched, notification.updated, mailbox.updated, system.

mailbox_id.title: Mailbox Id
mailbox_id.description: Mailbox to send from; null = first that can send

ImapConnectionOut.title: ImapConnectionOut
ImapConnectionOut.description: Current IMAP/SMTP settings of a mailbox, without passwords (to prefill the edit form).

ImapCredentialsPatch.title: ImapCredentialsPatch
ImapCredentialsPatch.description: Like ImapCredentials, but blank passwords keep the saved ones. smtp_host null turns sending off.

can_send.title: Can Send
can_send.description: Can send email (Gmail send permission or SMTP configured)

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, e.g. plan_limit, invalid_code

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: RFC 9457 error body returned for every non-2xx response.

task_backlog.title: Task Backlog
task_backlog.description: Background tasks waiting for a worker (consumer-group lag)

compose_enabled.title: Compose Enabled
compose_enabled.description: Allow sending email from WhatsApp with /email

queued.title: Queued
queued.description: false when a sync for this mailbox is already pending

command.title: Command
command.description: What to send on WhatsApp, e.g. /email leave

form.title: Form
form.description: The copyable form the bot replies with

status.title: Status
status.description: WORKING, SCAN_QR_CODE, STARTING, STOPPED, FAILED, MISSING, UNREACHABLE

qr.title: Qr
qr.description: data: URL of the pairing QR when status is SCAN_QR_CODE
